engine.notes: Fresno has no improv theatre with a working website. Armpit Theater's site (armpitimprov.com) returns a host 'site not found' page though its Facebook still advertises teen classes, Blimprov's domain is for sale, and Brian's Beard Improv, which calls 1410 N Del Mar 'Fresno's improv home' and runs an improv fest, lives on Instagram and Facebook only. The best-documented classes are term courses at

entries.name: The Company Studio
entries.area: Tower District (GCP's Annex, N Wishon Ave)
entries.summary: Good Company Players' nonprofit training program in the Tower District, running term-length improv classes at GCP's Annex alongside dance and theatre skills.
entries.schedule: IMPROV: The Thursday Crew, Thursdays 5:15pm, Aug 27 - Nov 5; Advanced Improv Saturdays 5:15pm, Sep 5 - Nov 21
signals: Backed by Good Company Players' production staff
Advanced improv 'Been There, Wooshed That!' Sep 5 - Nov 21
entries.reasons: The only dated, term-based improv classes with an institutional home in Fresno, but only two sections a term and no public improv shows.

entries.name: Clovis Community Education
entries.summary: Clovis Unified's adult-education programme runs Character Improv with Michael Robles, a seven-session evening class ending in a live performance.
signals: Also an Improv class for ages 10+
entries.reasons: A real, affordable public-enrolment improv class with a showcase, but a single section inside an adult-ed catalogue with no shows or community.

entries.name: United Conservatory of Music & Arts
entries.area: North Fresno (6759 N First St) and Clovis
entries.summary: A music and arts conservatory whose acting department runs a 10-week improv series for kids, teens and adults focused on storytelling and character.
entries.schedule: Adults Sundays 12-1:30pm, teens Mondays 5pm, kids Sundays 1:45pm; page shows a March start
signals: No pricing listed; page dates are stale
entries.reasons: A genuine adult improv series at a permanent school, but it is a side offering with undated pricing and a page that still shows a March start.
